expected: Find grade-matched bulk spectra and candidate CUBE/transition inputs
observed: No candidate-relevant electronic-structure files supplied; fixtures are synthetic
workaround: Actual MCP smoke tests only; fixtures excluded from material evidence
impact: Candidate Orbital analysis blocked; no demonstrated decision value
reusable_capability_and_success_criterio: Dataset intake distinguishes grade/thickness/conditions and fixture provenance; an unrelated fixture is never promoted into decision evidence.

expected: Launch MCP and list/call all five tools
observed: Earlier bundle lacked MCP; current integration uses the existing stdio recorder and dependency-backed CI.
workaround: Reuse the shared recorder and existing requirements; preserve actual discovery/results.
impact: Historical execution blocker resolved when current run succeeds; no new chemistry capability added.
reusable_capability_and_success_criterio: A portable locked environment launches real stdio MCP and records initialize/tools-list/calls/artifact hashes without a model key.
resolution: Resolved in this implementation; each run still records failures honestly.

expected: Inspect supplier PDF figures and export raw spectra
observed: Manufacturer PDF table readable; exact candidate wavelength arrays unavailable. Silica linked raw-data retrieval failed and its family caption describes a different thickness.
workaround: Retain facts, conditions and source locations; do not digitize, extrapolate or rescale.
reusable_capability_and_success_criterio: Store fetched PDF/raw spectra and make page images accessible; raw wavelength arrays preserve source figure/table and units.

expected: Apply optical/mechanical gates and then preference scoring
observed: Thresholds, impact, service life, detector response and budget absent
workaround: Conditional test-article nomination and sensitivity cases
reusable_capability_and_success_criterio: Three-state gate engine reports unknown separately from pass/fail; cannot export a production-approved decision with unresolved hard gates.

expected: Validate a complete Hardware IR and import it
observed: Archived 0.2 model is available and locally executable. Optical constraints remain free-form; current live schema and target project unavailable.
workaround: Validate with unmodified pinned Pydantic model, export its JSON Schema, and rerun structural/relationship checks in CI.
impact: Pinned schema validation resolved; remote import and typed optical qualification remain blocked.
reusable_capability_and_success_criterio: Expose versioned schema plus dry-run import; preserve optical evidence IDs and null unknowns in a round trip.

expected: Push isolated branch and open pull request
observed: Earlier work stopped at a patch. Current work uses an isolated branch and PR with CI evidence.
evidence: recovery.json and PR linked from issue #9
workaround: Publish source inputs and CI artifacts through existing repository workflow.
impact: Publication can be reviewed and reproduced; merge/final acceptance remain separate.
reusable_capability_and_success_criterio: Authenticated branch/PR write route returns URL and commit, then verifies remote tree matches submitted hashes.
resolution: Source and CI integration delivered through this PR; no direct default-branch write.

expected: Obtain stable stock/price and sheet formats
observed: Supplier views change; PMMA old/current format lists differ; PC SQ FT field is inconsistent with dimensions
workaround: Keep original basis and conflicting values; no area-price-to-delivered-cost conversion
reusable_capability_and_success_criterio: Version source retrievals, currency, units, quantity and quote status; dimension-unit contradictions trigger a review warning.
